health._note: Floor lowered from 4 to 0 on 2026-08-19, after it fired on three consecutive scheduled runs. Datadog genuinely SHRANK: 16 Israel-relevant postings at import on 2026-08-13, 3 now, and stable at 3 across runs - so this was the floor being stale, not a fetch breaking. Per the importer's own FLOOR_MIN_COUNT rule a board under 12 postings gets no absolute floor at all, because below that a floor causes more false alarms than it catches; the 4 was derived from a count the company no longer has. zero_is_plausible stays false - Datadog does hire in Israel, so a drop to zero is still worth hearing about, and the relative-collapse gate in state.py still covers sudden breakage without needing a number here.
